content.text: The Cubs look to snap a two-game losing streak on Sunday afternoon when they host the Pirates The Chicago Cubs host the Pittsburgh Pirates on Sunday afternoon in the final game of the three-game series. The Cubs came into the series on a two-game winning streak, but they lost the first game to the Pirates 2-0 and then lost 4-3 in 11 innings in the second game. The two-game losing streak has dropped the Cubs to 6-8 on the season, and they currently sit in last place in the NL Central. They will now turn to Jameson Taillon on the mound as they try to avoid being swept by the Pirates. Taillon comes into Sunday 0-1 on the season with a 2.53 ERA. He lasted six innings in his last start, giving up four runs on seven hits against the Tampa Bay Rays.
